All the services the Jewish Caring Network provides are free of charge and include, but are not limited to:

## Education

- Educational & Tutorial Program Support
- Dinner - Lecture Series
- Individual & Group Counseling
- Bereavement Counseling

## Healthcare

- Nursing Care
- Hospital Visitation, Meals & Packages
- Women's Rejuvenating Retreats

## Family Support

- Shabbat & Jewish Holiday Packages
- Complete Shabbat Meals
- Parent's Night Out
- Support Dinner-Lecture Series
- Day & Weekend Respite Retreats
- Women's Rejuvenating Retreats
- Tickets to Concerts, Plays, Amusement Parks, & Sporting Events
- Individual & Group Counseling
- Bereavement Counseling

## Children's Services

- Summer Camp Assistance
- Birthday Gifts & Parties
- Big Brother/Big Sister Program
- Educational & Tutorial Program

## Household Help

- Cleaning & Laundry Assistance
- Babysitting
- Groceries & Prepared Meals

## Travel & Holidays

- Passover Retreat Program
- Journey to Jerusalem
- Sunday Funday Program
- Tickets to Concerts, Plays, Amusement Parks and Sporting Events
- Day & Weekend Family Respite Retreats
